title: Bristol pub conversion secures £3.1m development finance
summary:
Shawbrook has provided £3.1m in development finance to convert a former Bristol pub into a 33-bed purpose-built student accommodation scheme. The 16-month facility is funding the redevelopment of The Old Tavern in Stapleton, with the project carrying an estimated gross development value of approximately £4.6m.

title: Three property firms expelled over unpaid compensation
summary:
The Property Ombudsman has expelled three property businesses from its redress scheme after they failed to pay compensation awards totalling over £1,000 to consumers. The action affects Musgrove & Co, Tothill Residential Surveying Ltd, and Coles Property Management.

title: Three London agencies announce senior appointments
summary:
Chestertons, Savills and Macclesfield-based Views have announced senior appointments across short lets, property management and development divisions. The moves come as firms expand operations and adapt to changing market conditions.

title: Property professionals back upfront information reforms
summary:
A survey of 300 property professionals has found that 77% are confident that proposed homebuying reforms will deliver positive change. The poll examined industry attitudes towards upfront property information requirements and their potential impact on transactions.

title: Nearly 40% of London flats resold at a loss in 12 months
summary:
Almost four out of ten flats in London were resold at a loss during the 12 months to August 2026, according to repeat-sales analysis from e.surv Chartered Surveyors. The data reveals concerns over leasehold, building safety and service charges are increasingly impacting flat values across Britain.

title: UK housing market momentum slows as interest rate concerns grow
summary:
The UK property market experienced a slowdown in September as rising interest rate expectations dampened buyer confidence, according to the latest RICS data. New buyer enquiries fell to -22% while house price pressures intensified, with the net balance dropping to -32%.

title: 43% of estate agency enquiries arrive outside office hours
summary:
Nearly half of all enquiries received by estate and letting agencies arrive outside normal working hours, according to data released by proptech firm LightWork AI. Analysis of calls, emails and portal enquiries during July to September 2026 found that 43% arrived outside the 9am to 5pm Monday to Friday window.

title: Conservatives pledge inheritance tax exemption for homes
summary:
Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch has announced plans to exempt family homes from inheritance tax if her party wins the next general election. The proposals would also provide couples with an additional £1 million allowance exempt from the levy.

title: Property Franchise Group invests £900,000 in AI platform
summary:
The Property Franchise Group has acquired a 25% stake in conversational AI platform Enteka Ai for £900,000. The platform is currently operational across more than 210 TPFG offices and handles enquiries across multiple channels including telephone, email, SMS, WhatsApp and live chat.

title: 44% of UK homeowners research property moves in secret
summary:
Nearly half of British homeowners have taken property-related actions without informing other adults in their household, according to research published by Zoopla. The property portal's study found that 44% of homeowners have secretly browsed homes for sale or checked their current property's value.
